Commit: bed45b21cb18f26f4d234422ebaa8b17e6624f05
Original source author: S. McColm
Lean4.24 compatibility port for classical Waring, with exact count semantics.
See smccolm_vmvt_port_manifest.json and smccolm_vmvt_port.patch for changes.
Status: full isolated Lean4.24 replay PASSED; final endpoints have only the standard three axioms.
Imported modules: all111 Wooley source modules plus minimal VmvtCore.
Waring.CriticalVMVT assembles the native endpoint and literal degree8/9 counts.
Only local import paths change at integration; declaration namespaces are preserved.
